verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API and an MCP server, so this axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of an interactive API reference with runnable examples: the docs site (docs.consensus.app) is Cloudflare-walled, and the OpenAPI spec linked from llms.txt points to a host that fails TLS. The anonymous MCP tier for trying the server before signing up is a different feature and is not an explorable API reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
